variants.name: Pork 100 g
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Meat and animal derivatives 45% (fresh pork 16%), minerals.

Analytical constituents: Crude protein 9.5%, Crude fibre 0.5%, Crude fat 5.5%, Crude ash 2.3%, Moisture 79.0%.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES/kg: Vitamin A (retinyl acetate) 2,500 IU, Vitamin D3 140 IU, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl acetate 3a700i) 5 mg, Taurine 500 mg.
variants.feeding_instructions: Recommended daily feeding intakes for adult cats (see table) may be split into 2 meals. Serve at room temperature. Once opened, keep refrigerated and consume within 2 days. Do not open the package if it is damaged or swollen. Store in a cool and dry place. Fresh and clean water should be available at all times. Cat food only, not suitable for human consumption.
